Thanks for contributing. Please fill in what you can — you can delete sections
that don't apply.

## What this changes

A one-paragraph description of the change.

## Why

What problem does this solve, or what improvement does it make?

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] New / updated reference implementation (code)
- [ ] Spec change (please make sure there is a Spec Change Proposal issue open first)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Chore / build / repo hygiene

## Related issues

Closes #

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see the Developer Certificate of Origin at <https://developercertificate.org/>.
- [ ] If this changes a published spec, there is a Spec Change Proposal issue linked above and it has been discussed there.
- [ ] I have not included any private / customer / operational data.
- [ ] I have not included any credentials, tokens, or keys.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything the reviewer should know — a tricky edge case, an assumption you
made, a follow-up that will land in a separate PR.
